# Result: Cannot compute

I cannot calculate the embedded emissions for this consignment. The ruleset says not to estimate when a required input is missing or not in the table, and one input is missing.

## Input check

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code in the factor table | CN 7202 11 (ferro-manganese, > 2% carbon) | ❌ **Not in table.** The table covers only 7201, 7206 10 00, 7207 11 90, and 7214 20 00. |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | China | ❌ **Cannot be matched.** China is listed for other CN codes, but there is no (7202 11, China) entry. Default values are selected by CN code and country together. |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | 500 t | ✅ Provided |

## Missing input

- **The default SEE (tCO2e/t) for CN 7202 11 (ferro-manganese, > 2% carbon) produced in China.** The supplied factor table has no entry for this CN code and country, so I cannot select a default value.

I did not use a value from another CN code as a proxy, such as pig iron (7201) for China at 1.66. The ruleset ties the default value to the specific good and country, so a substitute would be an estimate.

## To complete the calculation

Please provide an updated factor table that includes a default SEE for **CN 7202 11 / China**. The result will then be:

**Embedded emissions = SEE (7202 11, China) × 500 t**, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
